answer: A sable raven must fly each identity's proof through an onyx gate, and each new raven forces the flock to re-fly: the k-th fake pays k squared onyx in re-flight tolls, so ten fakes cost 385 and a hundred cost 338,350, while one honest identity pays 1. Ravens are keyed to one sable token, so clones cannot share a bird; if a raven drops, the flock re-flies and the toll stands.
